This will render figures in causal_files/figure-latex called mermaid-figure-1.png. (and Additional numbers). For now we are just copying them to figs/, but that can be automated. 

Here's a key for the figures: 

1. mermaid-figure-1.png is the Overall Framework Flowchart Figure
2. demand-pyramid.png is the Demand Space: How latent, unimagined, and actualized demand fit together
3. mermaid-figure-2.png is the Demand Flowchart Figure
4. mermaid-figure-3.png is the Capacity Flowchart Figure.
5. mermaid-figure-4.png is the Strategy Flowchart Figure.
6. mermaid-figure-5.png is the old more complex figure that integrates some details from all of the figures. 





```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-causal-overall
%%| fig-cap: "How constituent demand, capacity, political environment, and Legislator's strategic choices shape interbranch representation activities"
%%| fig-width: 6.5
%%| out-width: "100%"

flowchart TD
        CD["Constituent<br/>Demand"]
        IR["Legislator Office Capacity"]
        G["Legislator's Strategic<br/>Choices Shaped by Political Environment"]
        W["Work Done by<br/>Legislator Office"]
        L["Legislation"]
        A["Interbranch Representation"]
        C["Communications"]

    CD --> W
    IR --> W
    G --> W
    W --> L
    W --> A
    W --> C


```


```{r}
#| label: make-demand-pyramid
#| include: false
tikz_src <- r"(\documentclass[tikz,border=5pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
% Inverted pyramid, apex at (0,0); halfwidth at height y is 0.75*y.
% Three bands: y = 6..4, 4..2, 2..0.
\definecolor{band1}{gray}{0.88}
\definecolor{band2}{gray}{0.69}
\definecolor{band3}{gray}{0.50}

\draw[fill=band1, draw=black, line width=1pt]
  (-4.5,6) -- (4.5,6) -- (3,4) -- (-3,4) -- cycle;
\draw[fill=band2, draw=black, line width=1pt]
  (-3,4) -- (3,4) -- (1.5,2) -- (-1.5,2) -- cycle;
\draw[fill=band3, draw=black, line width=1pt]
  (-1.5,2) -- (1.5,2) -- (0,0) -- cycle;

\node[font=\sffamily\bfseries] at (0,5)   {Latent Demands};
\node[font=\sffamily\bfseries] at (0,3)   {Expressed Demands};
\node[font=\sffamily\bfseries\footnotesize, align=center] at (0,1.45) {Fulfilled\\Demands};

\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document})"
writeLines(tikz_src, "figs/demand-pyramid.tex")
if (requireNamespace("tinytex", quietly = TRUE) && tinytex::is_tinytex()) {
  # TinyTeX: this auto-installs any missing LaTeX packages (e.g. standalone)
  tinytex::xelatex("figs/demand-pyramid.tex")
} else {
  xl <- Sys.which("xelatex")
  if (xl == "") xl <- "/Library/TeX/texbin/xelatex"  # MacTeX's home
  if (!file.exists(xl)) stop("Can't find xelatex from R.")
  system2(xl, c("-interaction=nonstopmode",
                "-output-directory=figs", "figs/demand-pyramid.tex"),
          stdout = FALSE)
}
if (!file.exists("figs/demand-pyramid.pdf"))
  stop("TikZ compile failed - see figs/demand-pyramid.log for the LaTeX error")
suppressWarnings(
  pdftools::pdf_convert("figs/demand-pyramid.pdf", format = "png",
                        dpi = 300, filenames = "figs/demand-pyramid.png")
)
```

![The demand pyramid: from latent to expressed to fulfilled demands](figs/demand-pyramid.pdf){#fig-demand-pyramid}

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-causal-strategy
%%| fig-cap: "How legislator's strategic choices shape interbranch representation activities"
%%| fig-width: 6.5
%%| out-width: "100%"

flowchart TD
        PE["Political<br/>Environment"]
    subgraph strategic_g ["Legislator’s Strategic Choices"]
        G["What Work to Prioritize"]
        SA["How to Allocate Staff"]
    end
        W["Work Done by<br/>Congressional Office"]
        L["Legislation"]
        A["Interbranch Representation"]
        C["Communications"]
    PE ---> strategic_g
    G --> SA
    SA --> W
    W --> L
    W --> A
    W --> C

```


```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-causal-oldoverall
%%| fig-cap: "Original Figure: How constituent demand, capacity, political environment, and Legislator's strategic choices shape interbranch representation activities"
%%| fig-width: 6.5
%%| out-width: "100%"

flowchart TD
    subgraph demand_g ["Demand"]
        CD["Constituent<br/>Demand"]
    end
    subgraph capacity_g ["Capacity"]
        IR["Institutional Resource<br/>Allocation"]
        SC["Legislator's Staff<br/>Capacity"]
        MK["Legislator's<br/>Experience"]
    end
    subgraph env_g ["Environment"]
        PE["Political<br/>Environment"]
    end
    subgraph strategic_g ["Strategic Choices"]
        G["Legislator's Strategic<br/>Choices"]
        SA["Legislator's <br/> Staff Allocation"]
    end
    subgraph output_g ["Outputs"]
        W["Work Done by<br/>Congressional Office"]
        L["Legislation"]
        A["Interbranch Representation"]
        C["Communications"]
    end

    CD --> W
    PE --> G
    IR --> SC
    SC --> SA
    G --> W
    G -.-> SA
    MK --> W
    SA -.-> W
    W --> L
    W --> A
    W --> C
    C -.-> CD

    classDef output fill:#E69F00,stroke:#8A5F00,color:#1A1200;
    classDef demand fill:#56B4E9,stroke:#27607F,color:#04222F;
    classDef capacity fill:#009E73,stroke:#005A42,color:#00150F;
    classDef environment fill:#CC79A7,stroke:#7A4664,color:#2B0E1F;
    classDef strategic fill:#F0E442,stroke:#8A8020,color:#2B2800;
    class W,L,A,C output;
    class CD demand;
    class IR,SC,MK capacity;
    class PE environment;
    class G,SA strategic;

    style demand_g fill:#FBFBF9,stroke:#888780,color:#2C2C2A;
    style capacity_g fill:#FBFBF9,stroke:#888780,color:#2C2C2A;
    style env_g fill:#FBFBF9,stroke:#888780,color:#2C2C2A;
    style strategic_g fill:#FBFBF9,stroke:#888780,color:#2C2C2A;
    style output_g fill:#FBFBF9,stroke:#888780,color:#2C2C2A;
```
